name: NeoSapien
description: Connect NeoSapien to bring your memories, transcripts, and reminders from Neo 1 into Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NeoSapien to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NeoSapien to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.neosapien.xyz/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NeoSapien MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NeoSapien provides these MCP tools: export_memories, get_latest_memories_by_owner_name, get_memory_by_id, get_memory_transcript, get_reminders, list_all_memories, list_filtered_memories, search_memories, search_memories_metadata, and search_owners.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NeoSapien?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to NeoSapien in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
NeoSapien requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NeoSapien is developed by NeoSapien. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
